<PAGE>

                       Items to be Included in this Report

Item 5.03: Amendment to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal
Year

      Effective March 28, 2007, the Registrant amended its certificate of
incorporation to

            (a) change the name of the corporation from "Nesco Industries, Inc."
      to "Aquamatrix, Inc."; and

            (b) increase the authorized number of common shares to 400,000,000.

      In addition, the Registrant has notified the OTCBB of the name change, and
expects the OTCBB to change its ticker symbol from "NESK.OB" to reflect the new
name.
